notes.title: Gex Trilogy Update 2
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support of [b]Gex Trilogy[/b], the latest patch is live now and addresses the following issues.

[list]
[*] Corrected further audio errors for some users.
[*] Added end-of-level save game prompts.
[/list]

notes.title: Gex Trilogy Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support of [b]Gex Trilogy[/b], the latest patch is live now and addresses the following issues.

[list]
[*] Keyboard key remapping has been added to the options menu
[*] Addressed a startup issue for some users
[*] Corrected in-game audio errors for some users
[*] Updated credits
[/list]

Please direct any additional feedback to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3183970/discussions/0/528723987504607585/]Steam Support Thread[/url]. Thank you for playing [b]Gex Trilogy[/b]!
